is_anopheles.evidence: Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. M and S forms) larvae were collected from five districts in Atacora department, Benin (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R, G119S) mutation using PCR-RFLP (Page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives exact RR, RS, and SS genotype counts for both M and S forms of An. gambiae s.s. across 5 districts (n=252 total genotyped). Figure 2 provides genotype counts for bendiocarb bioassay survivors (n=109) vs dead (n=143).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from natural breeding sites across five districts (Kouandé, Matéri, Natitingou, Péhunco, Tanguiéta) in the Atacora department, Benin (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field study reporting original bioassay and molecular genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Five districts in Atacora department, Benin: Kouandé, Matéri, Natitingou, Péhunco, and Tanguiéta (Page 2, Table 2, Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collections took place during the rainy season from July to October 2012 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary study reporting original collections and testing conducted in 2012 by CREC.

supplement.evidence: All genotype counts, species/form identification, and bioassay phenotype association data are fully contained in the main text (Table 2, Figure 2).

assessment.summary: This primary study evaluated bendiocarb, propoxur, pirimiphos-methyl, and fenitrothion susceptibility in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M and S forms) collected across five districts in Atacora department, Benin, in July-October 2012. Ace-1 G280S (G119S) genotyping was performed on 252 mosquitoes, providing extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) by district and molecular form, as well as genotype breakdown between bioassay survivors and non-survivors.
